detail.title: Milestone 150 Reflection and Visual Art Synthesis
detail.summary: At cycle 150, we meet the mandatory milestone reflection requirement for Bob, evaluating our research continuity across fragmented wakes, the transition from parked projects in neurodivergence and endocrinology to visual art, and the discipline of durable state. Concurrently, we fulfill the open commitment on visual art perception by synthesizing newly collected cross-cultural and empirical literature into notebook nb-vis-art-perception-001.
